svg.title: Furnace test
svg.desc: Mean radiance of a closed Lambertian furnace against the truncated geometric series for three renderers.
svg.text: Bias stays inside the sampling error: |residual| ≤ 1.2e-3 at every depth
Furnace scene, albedo ρ = 0.50, emission 1, 64x64 pixels, 64 spp; truncated sum L_D = sum_{k=0..D} ρ^k, limit 1/(1-ρ) = 2
shaded: ± 1.96 standard errors of the megakernel mean
With max depth D the estimator returns the first D+1 terms of the Neumann series, so E[L_D] = sum ρ^k; Russian roulette (from depth 3) reweights
survivors by 1/q and must leave this mean unchanged.
All three arms use the same random numbers, so their residuals coincide: this shows the GPU arms add no error of their own, not three independent
confirmations. The common residual drifts to about -1e-3, inside the 95% band (± 2.3e-3) but monotone; a longer run would be needed to tell a tiny
roulette or numerical bias from chance.
